newsitem.title: USA: American Airlines offers special July 4 fare.
newsitem.headline: American Airlines offers special July 4 fare.

text.p: AMR Corp, parent company of American Airlines and American Eagle, said Wednesday that the airlines would offer special fares for the Fourth of July.

American and American Eagle will offer one-day advance purchase fares from $128 to $298 round trip in most markets, depending on the distance of the trip. The companies said a Friday night stay is required for July 4 departures and a Sunday night stay is required for July 5 departures.
The fares are available in all American and American Eagle markets in the 48 continguous United States and Canada.
